lines.tts: Hank. Small defense company. Just won... fifty MILLION dollars.
lines.caption: Hank. Small defense company. Just won fifty million dollars.

lines.tts: His plan? Do... none of the work.
lines.caption: His plan? Do... none of the work.

lines.tts: The engineer builds it. The tester tests it. The integrator integrates it.
lines.caption: The engineer builds it. The tester tests it. The integrator integrates it.

lines.tts: And Hank? [flatly] Hank forwards the emails.
lines.caption: And Hank? Hank forwards the emails.

lines.tts: Hank never controlled the work. His crew did.
lines.caption: Hank never controlled the work. His crew did.

lines.tts: That makes him an agent, not a principal. And agents only count their fee.
lines.caption: That makes him an agent, not a principal. And agents only count their fee.

lines.tts: Same cash in the bank. But on paper? His fifty million dollar company...
lines.caption: Same cash in the bank. But on paper? His fifty million dollar company...

lines.tts: [sighs] is a five million dollar company.
lines.caption: is a five million dollar company.

lines.tts: Don't be Hank. Direct the work. Own the results. Put it in writing.
lines.caption: Don't be Hank. Direct the work. Own the results. Put it in writing.

lines.tts: Revenue recognition. Defense Finance, on Ack-luh-rate.
lines.caption: Revenue recognition. Defense Finance, on Acqlerate.
